feeds.title: Escape Adulthood
feeds.description: Greetings and salutations! We are Kim and Jason: best friends, husband and wife, parents of three kids, entrepreneurs, authors, retro t-shirt wearers, and partners in crime on a crusade to annihilate Adultitis in ourselves and the world. Escape Adulthood is the cure for the common life. Don't settle for the life you've been told to live; create the one you were made for.

feeds.title: Boundless » Adulthood
feeds.description: Boundless is a community for Christian young adults who want to grow up, own their faith, date with purpose, and prepare for marriage and family. Life is complicated. From your body to bills to buying a home, part of growing up is dealing with the details of life. Take responsibility for the things God's given you.

feeds.title: Adulting Is Easy
feeds.description: Myself Lauren. I created the Adulting is Easy project as my 20's were coming to an end. What started as a concern about how unprepared for retirement most Americans are has morphed into a desire to help young people start preparing NOW by educating them. Adulting is Easy is a personal finance blog written to make saving, retirement, and adulting easier.

feeds.title: Keeping up with adulthood
feeds.description: Hi everyone! I'm Ceci and I am happy to share this blog about something that I always wanted to be, but never thought would be so difficult: being an adult. Join me as we journey together with the highs and the lows, with the fantastic and not so fantastic feelings, and find a way to help one another keep up with adulthood.

feeds.title: Adulting With Jane
feeds.description: Adulting with Jane is a short shoppable how-to comedy series with a different guest expert in each episode to teach Jane a new adulting skill. Learn even more Adulting 101 tips and tricks here.

feeds.title: Post-Grad Compass
feeds.description: Resources and tips for navigating post-college career and life, thriving in your post-college journey, from building your career, to adulting like a boss, to making meaning of it all.

feeds.title: Adulting Starts Here
feeds.description: Your go-to place to learn about Adulting. We share our experiences, tips, and insights to help you navigate adulthood.

feeds.title: Graced Girl
feeds.description: Covers articles about faith, finance, adulthood, entrepreneurship, travel, and lifestyle made with young adults in mind.
